assets.finalToolPrompt: Edit only the framing of this single transparent palm-frond texture. Keep the exact same ONE horizontally oriented pinnate frond, petiole at LEFT, pointed tip at RIGHT, natural gentle curve, individual narrow leaflets, muted dark olive/forest green colors, botanical details and neutral matte lighting. Uniformly shrink the whole existing frond by 20 percent without changing its proportions, then center it on the same square fully transparent canvas, leaving at least 12 percent empty transparent margin on both LEFT and RIGHT and generous transparent margin above and below. Every leaflet tip stays fully inside the frame. Do not draw extra fronds, change the leaf pattern or lighten the colors. No neon green or yellow fringe, no colored halo, trunk, ground, cast shadow, backdrop, text, border, scenery, UI or watermark. Preserve genuine transparent alpha in the background and between all leaflets. Square 1024x1024 PNG, reusable 3D palm alpha card.

assets.finalToolPrompt:
Edit target: the provided single grass tussock sprite.
Correct the alpha cutout and simplify the silhouette. Remove ALL bright neon green and yellow pixel artifacts around and between the leaves. Make the leaf surfaces natural subdued medium/dark neutral grass-green and muted brown, with clean realistically opaque leaf interiors, soft antialiased edges, and genuinely fully transparent holes between every leaf. There must be no chroma-key color fringe or tinted translucent background pixels anywhere.
Keep ONE photorealistic woodland-edge grass/sedge tussock in a square image with true RGBA transparency. Reduce the plant to approximately 30 visibly distinct slender narrow arching leaves from one compact basal crown, airy with open transparent gaps, about 0.6m tall and 0.7m wide. Fine narrow leaves, a few dry brown blades; graceful natural asymmetry. Move all leaf tips well inside the frame with a clear 12 percent fully transparent margin on ALL four sides. Neutral soft diffuse lighting, front view from slightly above, orthographic.
No soil, no ground, no cast shadow, no pot, no roots, no surrounding scene, no leaves or tips touching the edges, no flowers, no seedheads, no objects, no text, no watermark. Do not add a flat background or checkerboard. Save the complete plant silhouette on actual transparent background. This is an artistic generic vegetation sprite, not a species or surveyed location record.

assets.finalToolPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one genuine transparent PNG alpha-card foliage sprite for building rounded low 3D woodland shrubs. A dense but airy low broad-oval foliage mass, gently asymmetric, spreading more sideways than upward. A few fine natural brown twig branches visible through the foliage. Individually readable small leaves, matte medium forest green and deep green, restrained tonal variation, fine subtle veins, natural soft curl. Open empty gaps between leaf clusters. No flowers, no berries, no bright lime or yellow leaves. Camera: neutral orthographic view from the front and slightly above. Center the entire spray within the middle 75 percent of the square, leaving at least 10 percent genuinely transparent empty padding on every side; all twig and leaf tips fully visible inside the frame. Lighting: completely even neutral diffuse illumination with no strong directional highlight, no cast shadow. Full genuine alpha transparency in the background and all leaf gaps. Clean natural antialiased leaf edges with natural dark green edge color, no neon/lime/yellow halo, no green-screen color spill, no glowing fringe. No ground, no soil, no planter, no pot, no shadow, no scene, no backdrop, no text, no UI, no logo, no frame, no watermark. This is a generated material asset, not a documentary field photograph or species record. Single square transparent image, ideally 1024 by 1024 pixels.

assets.finalToolPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one opaque seamless square PBR base-color/albedo bitmap for the seven tiered conical roofs of an editable African Village model at Bursa Zoo. Input image role: roof surface material character ONLY from the small 2012 municipal reference photograph; it is not a guide to present-day geometry. Generate a NEW isolated material swatch, not the photograph, building, roof silhouette or scene. Subject: dark weathered brown-grey narrow wooden roof shingles or flat split wooden laths, laid in regular horizontal staggered offset courses. Fine narrow individual wood strips with subdued dry fibres running along the grain, restrained tiny broken or worn edges, shallow fine joints, natural subtle irregularity. Muted dark earthy brown, dry charcoal-brown and subdued grey weathering, low saturation and restrained color variation. The pattern should be dense and readable at close range without oversized planks, large cracks, deep black gaps or dramatic damage. Straight orthographic material scan perpendicular to surface, flat and full bleed. Neutral completely even diffuse lighting for an albedo map, no baked directional cast shadows, no specular highlights, no vignette and no ambient occlusion. Aim for perfectly seamless edge continuation on all four sides: horizontal courses, shingle scale, color and grain must wrap smoothly horizontally and vertically. No terracotta tile forms, no curved barrel tiles, no thatch fringe or straw, no moss clumps, no vegetation, no perspective, no roof edges/ridges, no objects, no building, no landscape, no text, no UI, no logo, no frame or border. One opaque RGB square bitmap, ideally 1024 by 1024 pixels.

Only a few tiny pale butter-yellow and ivory-white wildflowers scattered within the clump, no large blooms; flowers occupy less than 8 percent of the plant. Composition: one complete cluster centred in the square, entire plant within the central 78 percent of the image with at least 10 percent genuinely transparent empty padding on all four sides. True alpha transparency in the entire background and all gaps among leaves. Clean antialiased green/brown edges, no neon yellow or lime halo, no chroma-key spill, no translucent coloured backdrop. No soil, no ground patch, no pot, no planter, no roots, no surrounding environment, no horizon, no backdrop, no cast shadow, no visible checkerboard, no text, no UI, no logo, no watermark.
